Pezeshkian reiterated that climate change, over-extraction of groundwater, and poor water management have intensified the crisis. He previously warned in July that if water conservation is not improved, Tehran’s reservoirs could dry up by October. While past Iranian leaders have considered relocating the capital to the Persian Gulf region due to better water availability, Pezeshkian is the first to declare the move 'inevitable.'
